shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated rounded/oval motifs
earth-toned monochrome surface with worn/eroded texture
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry a horizontal register of repeated rounded, oval or disc-like motifs set against a plain ground, and both are weathered, earth-coloured surfaces. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a free-standing three-dimensional stone figure with motifs cut in low relief and organised into vertical stacked registers around a body, while B is a flat mud-plaster wall face with flat red-pigment painting in a single horizontal strip, so neither the technique nor the compositional logic corresponds.
